algorithm: {For each bin, if the bin has enough capacity to fit the item, assign a priority equal to the negative of the remainder when the bin's capacity is divided by the item's size, otherwise assign negative infinity to exclude non-viable bins.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return np.where(bins >= item, -(bins % item), -np.inf)

algorithm: {The algorithm computes for each bin a priority score equal to the negative of the remaining bin capacity after placing the given item into the bin, with a priority of negative infinity assigned to any bin that cannot fit the item.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return priorities
